haiku.problem: "Moab's false god Chemosh" adds "false," which isn't stated in the lesson's verses. The rules allow only facts from those verses.

The right answer's "him" could refer to the wine or to Moab, so the baker can't clearly tell who is poured out. The question also says the wine is "settled in its jars," but the verses say "settled like wine on its dregs" and mention jars only later, in verse 12.
